facts.text: Under the Sewanee Pledge, students who do not graduate in four consecutive years are provided up to one additional year of study tuition-free.

sources.title: The Sewanee Pledge | The University of the South | Sewanee

facts.text: Sewanee students are provided funding for a summer internship or research fellowship and a semester-long study-abroad opportunity at no additional tuition cost.
